callLines.text: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold REFUSES. debts unpaid between you. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)
— Stonebridge answers! Hank Hassan and Jesse Ibrahim and Felix Baker and Jesse Mendez will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield REFUSES. they do not trust this coalition with their people. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)

commit1Lines.text: 🛡️ Xavier, Ruby, Ozgur step forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.

commit2Lines.text: 🛡️ Haven commits its own: Xavier, Ruby, Ozgur march with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 7 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
